title: Anagram Problems
definition: Two strings are anagrams if they contain the exact same characters with the same frequencies. Solved efficiently in O(N) time using a fixed-size integer array of length 26 (Frequency Counter) for lowercase English letters.
simpleExplanation: Checking if you can rearrange the letters of 'LISTEN' to spell 'SILENT'.

answers.question: **Basic:** Valid Anagram (Frequency Counter)
**Advanced:** Group Anagrams
